import difflib, hashlib, json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'docs/evidence/pre_h03'
before=json.loads((out/'before.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
backup=Path(before['backup_root'])
skip={'.git','.godot','__pycache__'}
now={p.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and not skip.intersection(p.relative_to(root).parts) and not p.relative_to(root).as_posix().startswith('docs/evidence/pre_h03/')}
changed=sorted(k for k in before['files'] if k in now and before['files'][k]!=now[k])
removed=sorted(set(before['files'])-set(now))
added=sorted(set(now)-set(before['files']))
checks=[]
def check(name, condition, detail):
    checks.append({'check':name,'pass':bool(condition),'detail':detail})
    print(('PASS ' if condition else 'FAIL ')+name+': '+str(detail))
check('DOCUMENTATION_ONLY', not removed and not added and all(p.endswith('.md') and not p.startswith('docs/history/') for p in changed), {'changed':len(changed),'removed':removed,'added_outside_evidence':added})
protected=[p for p in before['files'] if not p.endswith('.md') or p.startswith('docs/history/')]
check('EXISTING_NON_DOCUMENTS_AND_HISTORY_UNCHANGED', all(now.get(p)==before['files'][p] for p in protected), len(protected))
olddec=(backup/'docs/DECISIONS.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
newdec=(root/'docs/DECISIONS.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
oldlines=[line for line in olddec.splitlines() if re.match(r'^- (D-|P-)',line) and not any(line.startswith('- '+i+' ') for i in ['D-001','D-015','P-004'])]
check('GAMEPLAY_DECISIONS_RETAINED', all(line in newdec.splitlines() for line in oldlines), str(len(oldlines))+' entradas idénticas; D-001/D-015/P-004 revisadas expresamente por arte')
oldgd=(backup/'docs/GAME_DESIGN.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
newgd=(root/'docs/GAME_DESIGN.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
check('GAME_DESIGN_ORIGINAL_LINES_RETAINED', all(line in newgd.splitlines() for line in oldgd.splitlines() if line), 'Todas las líneas originales siguen presentes')
oldvalidation=(backup/'docs/VALIDATION.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
newvalidation=(root/'docs/VALIDATION.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
check('PRIOR_VALIDATION_RETAINED', oldvalidation in newvalidation, 'Registro H02 completo conservado')
style='Modern PSX / Retro Industrial Cyberpunk'
core=['AGENTS.md','README.md','docs/ART_BIBLE.md','docs/GAME_VISION.md','docs/GAME_DESIGN.md','docs/MVP_SCOPE.md','docs/DECISIONS.md','docs/ROADMAP.md','docs/ASSET_REGISTRY.md','docs/HANDOFF.md','docs/DOCUMENTATION_AUDIT.md']
prompts=sorted((root/'prompts').glob('H*.md'))
check('OFFICIAL_STYLE_CORE_AND_PROMPTS', all(style.casefold() in (root/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8').casefold() for p in core) and len(prompts)==23 and all(style in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8') for p in prompts), str(len(core))+' documentos principales y 23 prompts')
active=[p for p in root.rglob('*.md') if not skip.intersection(p.relative_to(root).parts) and 'history' not in p.relative_to(root).parts]
groups={}
for p in active:
    groups.setdefault(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),[]).append(p.relative_to(root).as_posix())
duplicates=[v for v in groups.values() if len(v)>1]
check('NO_ACTIVE_IDENTICAL_DOCUMENTS', not duplicates, {'active':len(active),'duplicate_groups':duplicates})
check('NO_SUFFIX_DUPLICATES', all('(1)' not in p for p in now), 'Sin nombres (1) fuera de cachés/Git')
for name in ['import','startup']:
    stdout=(out/(name+'.stdout.log')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    stderr=(out/(name+'.stderr.log')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    meta=json.loads((out/(name+'.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    check('GODOT_'+name.upper()+'_LOGS',meta['exit_code']==0 and not stderr.strip() and not re.search(r'\b(ERROR|WARNING|SCRIPT ERROR|Parse Error)\b',stdout),'Exit '+str(meta['exit_code'])+', stderr vacío, sin indicadores de error/warning en stdout')
patch=[]
for p in changed:
    patch.extend(difflib.unified_diff((backup/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True),(root/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='before/'+p,tofile='after/'+p))
label='integrity_01'
(out/(label+'.diff')).write_text(''.join(patch),encoding='utf-8')
report={'changed_documents':changed,'removed':removed,'added_outside_evidence':added,'checks':checks,'errors':sum(not c['pass'] for c in checks),'scope':'Excluye .git/.godot/__pycache__ y nueva evidencia PRE-H03; verifica el resto por SHA-256.'}
(out/(label+'_report.json')).write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('RESULT '+str(len(checks)-report['errors'])+' PASS / '+str(report['errors'])+' FAIL')
print('\n'.join(changed))
sys.exit(1 if report['errors'] else 0)
